summary: Vidu's AI video platform hands new users trial credits at registration and keeps topping them up through daily login bonuses, letting you generate text-to-video and image-to-video clips without paying. Credits can also be earned through official events.
claim_steps: Register a free account at vidu.com.
Receive the sign-up trial credits automatically.
Log in daily to collect bonus credits.
Spend credits on text-to-video or image-to-video generations.
